ANLZ test fixtures
==================

Real rekordbox analysis files copied from a rekordbox export (PIONEER/USBANLZ/...). They let the libcdj
ANLZ parser tests run with no external data. File names are <P-dir>_<id-dir>_ANLZ0000.<ext>, i.e. the original
path USBANLZ/<P-dir>/<id-dir>/ANLZ0000.<ext> with '/' replaced by '_'. Files are byte-for-byte copies;
never edit or re-save them (checksums below; expected.tsv holds the matching database values).

They contain the track path/title of the owner's library (in PPTH and expected.tsv), no audio.

Source corpus facts (2184 tracks, 4368 analysis files + USBMNG.DAT, surveyed when these were picked)
  - the corpus has NO .2EX files, NO PSSI (phrase) tags, NO PWV6/PWV7: those parsers need synthetic tests
  - NO cue has a comment, NO memory points (PCOB/PCO2 type 0 is always empty), NO tempo changes (one tempo per grid)
  - PQT2 is missing exactly when the track was not analysed (empty beat grid): 5 tracks
  - the .DAT PCOB lists hold the same cues as the .EXT PCO2 lists (they are not empty for tracks with cues)
  - ANLZ header: len_header 0x1c, len_file equals the file size in every file

Files
-----
P02A_0000ECBE  -  smallest pair; track NOT analysed by rekordbox: empty PQTZ (len 24), no PQT2, no cues (10 s silence, bpm 0)
P042_00015D16  -  anchor track used in the plan: 716 beats, 123.00 BPM, first beat 51 ms, one hot-cue LOOP (31271..39076 ms), PCO2 entry is the short 0x2c form (no comment/colour)
P04B_000145BD  -  contains a PVB2 tag (only 2 files in the export have one); unanalysed (no PQT2, bpm 0)
P035_0002765B  -  a PCP2 entry longer than 0x2c: carries colour bytes (7 tracks in the export do)
P014_00001A7A  -  two hot cues (non-loop); DAT PCOB non-empty (cues are stored in both PCOB and PCO2)
P07D_0001A2E9  -  four cues, the most of any track in the export; longest beat grid here (859 beats)
P024_00023562  -  two loops (the only track in the export with more than one)

Second export (a small rekordbox 6+ style export made on purpose, 7 tracks, three kept here):
P004_00028148  -  loop cue B 14820..22205 ms = 16 beats (16/1) at 130.00 BPM, hot cues A (5 ms) and C; 521 beats
P00C_0000D1E2  -  loop cue B 57795..61404 ms = 8 beats (8/1) at 133.00 BPM, hot cues A (4 ms) and C; 521 beats
P022_0002380C  -  only two hot cues (A at 4 ms, B at 43359 ms); 525 beats
  In this export the first hot cue (A) of every track has 00 00 96 where other cues have 00 03 e8 (PCPT bytes 0x1d..0x1f,
  PCP2 bytes 0x11..0x13); still no memory points, comments, colours, PSSI or .2EX.

USBMNG_head.DAT  -  first 256 bytes of USBANLZ/USBMNG.DAT (magic PMNG, NOT an ANLZ file; truncated copy).
                    Negative test: the parser must reject it by magic.

Per-file size, checksum and tag list (fourcc@offset(header length, tag length)); produced by an independent
byte scanner, the parser tests compare against this
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
